missing_bridges: Separate local Frobenius eigenvalue weights |α|=q^(w/2) from complex global L-function zero coordinates; construct an exact comparison with all normalizations.
A general Fourier–Mukai kernel need not preserve irreducibility or support; supports even live on different spaces. Specify equivalence/kernel hypotheses and prove the intended relation.
Define Spec(IC(M_G)) and prove its all-zero trace realization. Derived-category formation localizes quasi-isomorphisms, not merely homotopy equivalences; retain this categorical distinction.
Construct the variable/normalization change and exact determinant/global analytic realization, with all convergence and weight hypotheses.

Complementary projector splitting supplies its finite-dimensional linear-algebra fragment once the maps and invariant filtration are instantiated. It does not supply incomplete tensor products, represented-image floors, bounded completion or the open global realization A02-O06.
missing_bridges: Construct the actual source null space and certified prime-block decomposition identified as A02-O04; abstract quotient descent does not supply them.

Construct the finite source maps r,E and idempotence/filtration adapter; extend separately to the paper’s completed Hilbert spaces.
Retain the original versus transported metric and value/residue/leading branch distinctions; one-excitation augmentation remains an open target.

reviews.read_extent: One additional selected complete physical page, or a reread when the short asset was already exhausted; other pages are cited from the preserved earlier review. Not a full-manuscript audit.
reviews.finding: The logarithm section uses rational independence to infer transcendence of algebraic-coefficient sums and cites prime-gap smoothing as preserving chaos. These arguments do not supply an infinite-sum transcendence theorem, and no maintained Baker/motivic-independence target was established.
missing_bridges: Density/quasi-randomness does not imply a sum is transcendental or cannot cancel. Define the infinite sum and prove an actual transcendence theorem with algebraic coefficient hypotheses.
Logarithm independence must specify linear/algebraic and coefficient fields; modularly dense phases are a different assertion.
Functional equations relate specified paired values with gamma/conductor factors, not all critical and noncritical values. Preserve the conditional motivic period and analytic-continuation scope.
Separate finite nonzero algebraic-coefficient logarithmic forms from convergent infinite sums; prove coefficient hypotheses, nonvanishing and the required transcendence result.
